Install HextaUI with the shadcn CLI
Pass a component's registry URL to the CLI. It copies the source into your project, installs its dependencies, adds the theme tokens and pulls in any HextaUI components it builds on.
Register HextaUI in `components.json` to add components by name.
The files are yours from then on. Import them from `@/components/ui` and edit them like any other code.
